title: Patch: no rarity foil on Legendary and Mythic cards by default; the crest and the music set them apart
notes: R2721000: Legendary and Mythic faces wear no rarity foil by default; the Rarity foil setting gives the Mythic its sheen and rainbow edge back. Radiant faces keep their foil. How cards look only: nothing plays differently.

player.title: Quieter Legendary and Mythic cards
changes: Mythic cards no longer shine with a rainbow foil and edge by default: like Legendary cards, they stand out by the crest at the top, their gem and their music.
Turn on Rarity foil in Settings, Visuals, to bring the Mythic's rainbow foil and edge back.
A Mythic card now shows the cosmetic foil you equip on it.
